title: Medico Economic Evaluation of Fluocinolone Acetonide Implant Versus Dexametheasone Implant in Resistant Diabetic Macular Oedema
official: EMMA - Medico Economic Evaluation of Fluocinolone Acetonide Implant Versus Dexametheasone Implant in Resistant Diabetic Macular Oedema
summary: Main objective: To assess the cost-utility ratio at 3 years of treatment with fluocinolone acetonide (FA) intravitreal implant compared with treatment with dexamethasone (DXM) intravitreal implant in the treatment of resistant DME in pseudophakic patients, from a societal point of view

interventions.name: ILUVIEN 190 microgrammes, implant intravitréen avec applicateur
OZURDEX 700 micrograms intravitreal implant in applicator

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients who have given their free, informed and written consent
2. Patients aged 18 and over
3. Patient with DME greater than 300 microns central foveolar thickness still present after at least 2 years of treatment and responsible for a drop in visual activity
4. Patient who has had at least one anatomically and functionally effective DXM injection for more than 4 months
5. Patient who has had an anti-VEGF injection for more than 3 months
6. Pseudophakic patient with surgery more than 6 months ago
7. Patients with uni- or bilateral diabetic macular oedema (in the case of bilateral diabetic macular oedema, the most affected eye will be included in the study)
8. Best Corrected Visual acuity (BCVA) ≤ 80 letters ETDRS
Exclusion criteria:
1. Person who is not affiliated with the national health insurance system
2. Patient unable to give consent
3. Patients with a known hypersensitivity to the active substance or to one of the excipients of Ozurdex® or Iluvien®
4. Patients who have already participated in the study
5. Patient for whom the follow-up required by the protocol is not feasible (moving house, etc.)
6. Patients with pre-existing uveitis or glaucoma or active or suspected ocular or periocular infection, including most viral diseases of the cornea and conjunctiva, including active epithelial herpes simplex keratitis (dendritic keratitis), vaccinia, varicella, mycobacterial infections and mycoses
7. Glycated haemoglobin > 12%.
8. In the eye studied : -	Patient who received an injection of Iluvien (fluocinolone acetonide) less than 24 months ago
9. In the eye studied : Patients with untreated severe proliferative or non-proliferative diabetic retinopathy
10. In the eye studied : Patients who have undergone pan-retinal photocoagulation or focal treatment within the last 3 months
11. In the eye studied : Patients with capillary macroaneurysms accessible to focal laser treatment
12. In the eye studied : Patients with ocular hypertonia > 21 mmHg despite treatment with more than 2 molecules
13. In the eye studied : Aphakic patients or patients with a history of capsular rupture and wearing an iris-fixed or transcleral implant
14. In the eye studied : Phakic patients
15. Person subject to a measure of legal protection or a court order
16. Pregnant, parturient or breast-feeding women
